_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Pet Supplements Program Manual for Category 18. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.pet-supplements is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 18 Program Manual. Seven live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on the program retest schedule. Metal safety only.
